passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: This is our computer, and it has a screen and a keyboard.
phrases.ko: 이것은 우리 컴퓨터이고, 화면과 키보드가 있어요.
phrases.zh: 这是我们的电脑，它有屏幕和键盘。
phrases.py: zhè shì wǒ men de diàn nǎo， tā yǒu píng mù hé jiàn pán。
wǒ diǎn jī， yě xué xí。

phrases.en: I play a game for a short time.
phrases.ko: 나는 짧은 시간 동안 게임을 해요.
phrases.zh: 我玩一会儿短短的游戏。
phrases.py: wǒ wán yī huì er duǎn duǎn de yóu xì。

phrases.en: I am careful, and then I turn off the computer.
phrases.zh: 我很小心，然后关掉电脑。
phrases.py: wǒ hěn xiǎo xīn， rán hòu guān diào diàn nǎo。

phrases.en: The screen is bright, so I sit back a little.
phrases.ko: 화면이 밝아서 나는 조금 떨어져 앉아요.
phrases.zh: 屏幕很亮，所以我坐得稍远一点。
phrases.py: píng mù hěn liàng， suǒ yǐ wǒ zuò de shāo yuǎn yì diǎn。

phrases.en: I learn English words on the computer.
phrases.zh: 我在电脑上学英语单词。
phrases.py: wǒ zài diàn nǎo shàng xué yīng yǔ dān cí。
wán yī huì er yóu xì jiù gòu le。

phrases.en: I am careful because not everything online is good.
phrases.ko: 온라인의 모든 것이 좋은 것은 아니라서 나는 조심해요.
phrases.zh: 网上不是每样东西都好，所以我很小心。
phrases.py: wǎng shàng bú shì měi yàng dōng xī dōu hǎo， suǒ yǐ wǒ hěn xiǎo xīn。

phrases.en: Mom asks me to turn off the computer at night.
phrases.zh: 晚上妈妈让我关掉电脑。
phrases.py: wǎn shàng mā mā ràng wǒ guān diào diàn nǎo。

phrases.en: Then the screen is dark, and I read a book.
phrases.ko: 그러면 화면이 어두워지고, 나는 책을 읽어요.
phrases.zh: 然后屏幕暗了，我去看书。
phrases.py: rán hòu píng mù àn le， wǒ qù kàn shū。

full_passage_spoken: This is our computer, and it has a screen and a keyboard. I use the mouse. I click and learn. I play a game for a short time. I am careful, and then I turn off the computer. The screen is bright, so I sit back a little. I learn English words on the computer. A short game is enough. I am careful because not everything online is good. Mom asks me to turn off the computer at night. Then the screen is dark, and I read a book.
full_passage_zh: 这是我们的电脑，它有屏幕和键盘。我使用鼠标。我点击，也学习。我玩一会儿短短的游戏。我很小心，然后关掉电脑。屏幕很亮，所以我坐得稍远一点。我在电脑上学英语单词。玩一会儿游戏就够了。网上不是每样东西都好，所以我很小心。晚上妈妈让我关掉电脑。然后屏幕暗了，我去看书。
